description: Returns the current date and time as an ISO 8601 timestamp with its UTC offset, in the person's time zone when it is known and otherwise in UTC. Claude has no clock of its own, so it calls this tool, rather than running a command, whenever an answer depends on the current time or date: the time of day, today's date, or how long it is until or since something.
name: mcp__claude_ai__current_time
